visual_action: The video first shows a screenshot of a tweet from an account named 'FactPost'. The tweet text announces that Donald Trump has failed to win the Nobel Peace Prize. Below the text are two images side-by-side: one of Donald Trump looking up, and one of a Nobel prize medal. The video then cuts to a close-up clip of a small hamster with large, sad-looking eyes, with the text 'trump rn:' overlaid.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is named in the tweet text ('Donald Trump has failed to win...') and a photo of him is shown in the screenshot.

cast.name: FactPost
cast.evidence: The name 'FactPost' and handle '@factpostnews' are displayed as the author of the on-screen tweet.

on_screen_text.text: Donald Trump has failed to win the Nobel Peace Prize after months of desperate public campaigning.

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; it is accompanied only by instrumental music.
audio_music: A slow, mournful, and comically sad violin piece plays throughout the entire video to mock the subject's supposed disappointment.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a static image of a tweet, which then cuts to a single meme video clip of a hamster.
central_claim: Donald Trump is comically sad and pathetic after failing to win the Nobel Peace Prize.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump and encourage viewers to laugh at his perceived failure and disappointment.
uncertainty_flags: The authenticity of the 'FactPost' tweet screenshot is uncertain; it could be from a satirical account or entirely fabricated for the meme.
